arguments.value: Andre Birotte, Jr. is a United States District Judge for the Central District of California, appointed by President Barack Obama in 2014. Born in Newark, New Jersey, he earned his B.S. from Tufts University and his J.D. from Pepperdine University School of Law. He began his legal career as a deputy public defender in Los Angeles County before serving as an assistant U.S. attorney in the Central District of California, entering private practice in Los Angeles, and then serving on the Los Angeles Police Commission as both assistant inspector general and inspector general. Prior to his judicial appointment, he served as U.S. Attorney for the Central District of California from 2010 to 2014.
